label: V25 credit-aware post-hoc with inner-OOF teacher
formula: Fit four credit interactions to inner3fold-OOF corrected-Kumo offset on6000 correction rows: meanBCE(offset+R@gamma)+.03/2||gamma||^2+.2/2 mean((R@gamma)^2). R is support-gated, main-effect-residualized late30*allocation-reliability, installment*conditional-deficit, installment*outflow-pressure, and total-burden*allocation-sparsity. Ridge projection .001, reference fitting on6k only. No intercept. Inference eta=logit(p_V25_corrected)+.25*clip(R@gamma,-.3,.3); final=.75*sigmoid(eta)+.25*original_spline; test mean5folds.
rationale: V25 already has credit main effects; audit showed no significant one-dimensional residuals. Test four small conditional effects instead of aggressive rules or outer-label tuning. Honest inner-OOF teacher avoids fitting the new head to in-sample original correction residuals. Identical existing outer folds, no new Kumo inference or backbone gradients. Post-audit choice and repeated outer-fold reuse remain selection risks; not a verified reproduction of an unidentified friend method.
head_gap_caveat: The new head training diagnostic reuses its6k fitting labels; utility must be assessed only on14k outer rows. Inner teachers use disjoint4000/2000 partitions; original spline is never a6k training teacher.
